import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if line == '':
        s = None
    else:
        s = line.rstrip('\n')
    
    res = 0
    if s is not None and len(s) > 1:
        a = list(s)
        n = len(a)
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and a[j] == a[j - 1]:
                j += 1
            if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
                res += 1
            i = j
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
